results.name: aksMembership
results.reason: Current preview schema 2023-09-01-preview accepts writable properties.targetId as a tenant-scoped Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups ARM ID, matching serviceGroupId; scope selects target member resource via resourceUri. The exact GA 2026-08-01 schema was also compared: sourceId is required/writable and targetId is read-only/server-derived.
results.migration: GA移行は可能だが現状のままでは不可。candidate 2026-08-01ではserviceGroupIdをproperties.sourceIdへ移し、properties.targetIdを送らない。Bicep scopeは対象memberのまま。

findings.detail: 最新GA 2026-08-01はrelationship方向を変更: sourceIdが必須のService Group resource ID、targetIdはscopeからserver-derived/readOnly。現在のpreview本文はtargetId=serviceGroupIdなので、GA移行時はproperties.sourceIdへ移しtargetIdを削除する必要がある。
